scope: Eighteen new native Cabin composites per cut, four genuine cuts. Geometry, glyph advances and every existing source pair value are unchanged. This explicitly extends only new glyph memberships to retain their actual native base spacing roles.
rules: For each actual kern PairPos subtable, inherit the source base role on both sides. Add first-glyph coverage only when the original source base was covered.
For class PairPos, copy the actual source ClassDef1/ClassDef2 values, including real default-zero roles. Do not introduce a new nonzero class, matrix value or generic all-glyph coverage.

For explicit PairPos, reproduce the original base pair records for the new left/right names and their applicable new-to-new combinations. Values come from the exact old base-to-base record, with no duplicated pair or altered old entry.

Retain lookup order, flags, features and every original name-to-class/pair value. Coverage/class maps may gain only the declared new glyph names; do not claim raw table-byte equality for an extended table.
New Ezh-with-caron follows its newly added Ezh role, which has no invented native Cabin kerning membership. Noncomposable Fira supplements do not receive a donor layout/GID graft.
